visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white sleeveless ribbed knit top, white shorts, and white arm warmers, poses with her hand behind her head. She stands next to a small 3D figurine that perfectly replicates her outfit and pose. The background features a large glass window showing a street and a white car, under bright indoor lighting. (2) The shot shifts to the exterior of a retail store called 'Suoxiang 3D Figurines' located near Taichung High Speed Rail Station. The storefront has glass doors adorned with Christmas stickers and a sign indicating business hours. A white scooter is parked partially in the frame on the right side. (3) Inside the shop, the camera pans across a white shelf displaying multiple 3D figurines protected by glass domes. One figurine shows a father in a blue shirt holding a child, another shows a young girl in a purple outfit, and another features a woman in a black bodysuit. The lighting is bright and even. (4) The woman is seen inside a specialized 3D scanning booth, which is a circular structure with a white interior and many black camera lenses and LED light strips integrated into the walls. She stands in the center, holding a specific pose with her arms raised, remaining completely still for the scanning process. (5) A man with vibrant blue hair and the woman, now wearing a pink oversized hoodie, pose together inside the circular scanning booth. They stand back-to-back with casual expressions, demonstrating that the booth can accommodate couples. The background consists of the white, high-tech interior of the scanning equipment. (6) A close-up shot focuses on the back of a male figurine, showcasing an impressively detailed and colorful tattoo of a Buddhist deity that covers his entire back. The figurine is held by a hand, emphasizing the precision of the 3D printing technology in capturing intricate skin details and colors. (7) The woman holds a small 3D figurine of herself in a white outfit, posing it in front of the camera while she smiles broadly in the background. The figurine is an exact miniature of her, showcasing the final product's quality. The background is a slightly blurred shop interior with blue and yellow star decorations. (8) Multiple figurines are shown on a white surface, including one of the blue-haired man in a grey tracksuit and blue-accented jacket. A hand holds the miniature version of him in front of his face, creating a 'mini-me' comparison. The lighting is bright studio-style, highlighting the textures of the figurine's clothing. (9) In the final scene, the woman and the blue-haired man are at a counter inside the shop. The man speaks while the woman laughs heartily, showing her teeth and squinting her eyes in a joyful expression. They are looking at the 3D figurines they have created, surrounded by the store's retail environment.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy, upbeat pop background track featuring electronic synth melodies and a steady 4/4 drum beat. A female narrator speaks with a bright, enthusiastic tone, high pitch, and clear articulation, introducing the concept of 3D figurines. The vocal delivery is fast-paced and professional. (2) As the narration continues, the background music maintains its tempo, providing a cheerful foundation. The narrator describes the shop's location in Taichung, with her voice centered and well-produced. There are no noticeable ambient noises, suggesting a high-quality studio recording for the voiceover portion of the video. (3) The narrator explains the variety of sizes available, her voice exhibiting dynamic pitch contours to maintain viewer engagement. The music features a repetitive, catchy synth hook. The spectral brightness is high, giving the audio a crisp and modern feel typical of social media promotional content. (4) When discussing pets and children, the narrator's tone becomes slightly more warm and affectionate, though still maintaining high energy. The music continues without interruption, well-balanced under the vocals. The speech-to-music ratio is favorable, ensuring the narration is the primary focus. (5) The audio transitions to live-recorded dialogue in the shop. A male voice with a lower pitch and more relaxed, conversational tone is heard speaking. The woman responds with loud, genuine laughter, which creates a high-arousal acoustic event. The BGM volume ducks slightly to accommodate the natural dialogue. (6) The segment ends with the woman expressing her opinion on the figurines. Her voice is clear, with a rising intonation that suggests playfulness and humor. The background music swells back to its original volume as the video concludes, ending on a bright and positive tonal note.
